Capgo and Appflow take different paths when it comes to managing app updates. Capgo zeroes in on web asset updates, allowing developers to instantly push changes without waiting for app store approvals. It uses a channel system to make updates more targeted, letting developers roll out changes to specific user groups for beta testing or phased deployments
One standout feature of Capgo's update system is its ability to send only the modified parts of an update. This approach reduces both bandwidth usage and the time it takes to deliver updates
"Cancelled my @Appflow subscription after 4 years. Code-Push never seemed to work well, hopefully @CapGO has it figured out" - LeVar Berry
